### Schneider National, Inc. announces participation in upcoming conference


August 31, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/901178831/files/doc_news/Schneider-National-Inc--announces-participation-in-upcoming-conference-62c16b964-2026.pdf)


GREEN BAY, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, today announced participation in the following investment conference:


- **2026 Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference:** Tuesday, **** September 15, 2026. Jim Filter, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Darrell Campbell, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat and a series of investor discussions. The chat will begin at 4:05 p.m. (Pacific Time) / 6:05 p.m. (Central Time).


A webcast for this event may be located on Schneider’s Investor Relations website ([www.investors.schneider.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.schneider.com%2Finvestors%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54596786&newsitemid=20260831996391&lan=en-US&anchor=www.investors.schneider.com&index=1&md5=d77e17b57a670855645ff6dcf6f6d383) ) and available for a limited time following the conference.


**About Schneider**


Schneider is a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, helping customers turn supply chain complexity into greater control. Backed by more than 90 years of operational expertise and innovation, Schneider delivers reliable, flexible and responsible solutions that help businesses move freight with confidence.


Schneider’s broad portfolio includes[Regional](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fschneider.com%2Ffreight-shipping-solutions%2Fregional-haul&esheet=54596786&newsitemid=20260831996391&lan=en-US&anchor=Regional&index=2&md5=7808e0b3380f6156040ef753baa337ee) and[Long-Haul](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fschneider.com%2Ffreight-shipping-solutions%2Flong-haul&esheet=54596786&newsitemid=20260831996391&lan=en-US&anchor=Long-Haul&index=3&md5=ab5e522917bf76cd78dc79fb54367a65)
